setting.note: The full NHI Crisis has not happened in this player-facing timeline. Disclosures, leaks, incidents and smaller crises have; global collapse, a visible alien society and an interstellar standoff have not.

shifts.name: AGI / ASI
shifts.public_position: Advanced and potentially superintelligent AI, androids, rogue systems and cybernetic augmentation are regulated fields of engineering and law.
shifts.contested: Capability ceilings, licensing boundaries, and what a rogue system actually is.

shifts.name: PSI
shifts.public_position: Psychic phenomena and consciousness science are studied by serious institutions and regulated as licensed practice.
shifts.contested: Replication, interpretation, and how much of it is psi rather than fraud, attention or coercion.

shifts.name: NHI
shifts.public_position: Non-human intelligence is a recognised category in law, science and security policy after disclosures and incidents.
shifts.contested: What the category actually contains; most people have never met an NHI, and genuine activity is distant or mediated.

objectives.name: Stability
objectives.mandate: Keep destabilising manifestations out of ordinary streets, media cycles and everyday experience where possible.
objectives.tension: Secrecy and censorship against civil liberties and democratic oversight.

objectives.name: Sustainability
objectives.mandate: Maximise the benefits of the three shifts while minimising existential risk.

objectives.name: Security
objectives.mandate: Detect, contain, investigate and prevent X-Risks from becoming catastrophes.
objectives.tension: Prevention against proportionality, evidence standards and the presumption of innocence.

objectives.name: Survival
objectives.mandate: Prepare contingency plans to preserve Homo sapiens populations if prevention fails.
objectives.tension: Continuity planning against the politics of who is included, and against normalising catastrophe.

cases.title: The asset that asked for a lawyer
cases.question: Is this an unregistered autonomous system, a licensed tool being misused, or a person's livelihood being criminalised?
outcomes: operator charged, system preserved as evidence
no crime: a licensing failure resolved administratively
cover-up by the operator's institutional client

cases.title: The unlicensed reading
cases.question: Did an unlicensed practitioner cause the incident, or did the incident cause the practice to be noticed?
outcomes: a fraud, with real harm and no psi at all

cases.title: The proxies of nobody in particular
cases.question: Is this group acting for a non-human patron, for a human sponsor, for itself, or for no one?
outcomes: an indirect, deniable non-human connection that cannot be proved in court
